notes: Synthetic: authored from Groq's official SDK, github.com/groq/groq-python v1.7.0 (2026-08-25), whose types are generated from Groq's OpenAPI spec: types/chat/chat_completion.py, chat_completion_message.py, chat_completion_chunk.py, completion_usage.py and completion_create_params.py (reasoning_format, reasoning_effort). console.groq.com was not reachable from the authoring sandbox. Naming: an OpenAI-compatible upstream's fixtures are keyed <preset>@<upstream model ID>, so this is the groq preset (providers/presets.go) serving model openai/gpt-oss-120b; the directory is that key as contracttest.ModelDir encodes it. Groq's divergences from OpenAI: the parsed reasoning comes back as message.reasoning (not reasoning_content), usage carries queue/prompt/completion/total timings, and x_groq / usage_breakdown / service_tier "on_demand" sit at the top level. Top-level and usage extras reach the client through Extra. stream_reasoning follows the SDK's chunk type and its streaming example (examples/chat_completion_streaming.py), which reads usage from x_groq.usage on the finish chunk; x_groq.id comes on the first and final chunk and x_groq.seed on the final one, as XGroq documents. Groq's SDK documents no stream_options, so the fixture carries no top-level usage even though the gateway asks for include_usage; a recording should confirm. max_tokens stays max_tokens: normalizeMaxTokens only rewrites it for api.openai.com.

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: known gap GQ1: Groq's parsed reasoning (message.reasoning, sent when reasoning_format is "parsed") is dropped; models.Message has reasoning_content, the canonical slot for it, but the adapter decodes the body as is and nothing maps one to the other, so clients get no reasoning from Groq reasoning models
known gap GQ2: Groq's streamed reasoning (delta.reasoning) is dropped; models.Delta has reasoning_content, the canonical slot for it, so streaming clients get no reasoning either
known gap O3: streamed choice logprobs are dropped (models.StreamChoice has no logprobs field). Always null from Groq, whose SDK documents logprobs as not yet supported by any model
